answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Thatcher apprenticeship record with master thatcher attestation changes that arithmetic: each record is roofs thatched and inspected by a master thatcher, so a hundred fakes need a hundred real thatchers, so the gale for each fake is paid in the real world. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the nebula of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The glacier is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
